CA.rationale: Content (red locations) is explicitly linked to a processing origin (command_estimate) for the same candidate/time.

COD.rationale: For p0/current/n0 the report lists the red content, an explicit origin/status entry, and presentation/organization context.

A.rationale: Processing/origin labels (e.g. command_estimate) are explicitly associated with the same candidate content entries.

C.rationale: The report enumerates identified contents (red/blue) with explicit coordinate lists for multiple referents/times.

D.rationale: Origins/status entries are provided separately from the coordinate content listings, distinguishing content identification from status/ provenance.

O.rationale: The text describes layout orientation and presents grouped candidate/current content listings, indicating how content is organized/presented.
